description: Verify Wave0 produced shared foundation evidence: _INDEX.md and README.md exist, 00-shared-*.md reference files exist (count_floor >=1), per-topic thin YAML exists in artifacts/wave0/ and passes ReferenceMetadata schema validation, and trace evidence is present. Source-gate status-window and handoff witness are enforced by shared gate preflight.

rules.failure_message: Missing file: reference/_INDEX.md. Write a canonical Markdown table inventory of all reference files with columns: ref_file, source_type, trust_level, tier, related_topic, source_layer, acceptance_status, date_landed.
Missing file: reference/README.md. Write a brief human-readable overview of the flat reference directory convention.
Missing directory: reference/. Create the directory and populate with 00-shared-*.md reference files.
Fewer than 1 00-shared-*.md reference file in reference/. Create at least one shared foundation reference file per shared-reference-template.md.
A 00-shared-*.md file contains placeholder source_url (example.com). Delete the placeholder file and write a real reference or suppl-failure-r{N}.md instead.
Missing per-topic thin YAML: artifacts/wave0/{topic}/source.yaml. Search and collect at least foundation floor count of references for each topic in the topic_registry.
Reference metadata in artifacts/wave0/{topic}/source.yaml fails schema validation. Each entry must have url, title, retrieved_date (YYYY-MM-DD), and topic_tag.
Topic {topic} has fewer than 1 reference metadata entries in artifacts/wave0/{topic}/source.yaml. Collect at least the foundation floor count for each topic.
No wave0_completion trace event found in rb_trace.jsonl. The phase must write a completion trace event per the shared-subagent-protocol.
检测到虚假或重复 reference 文件

Cache trail coverage gap detected: role=reference output files must map to verified _cache/ leaf directories. Missing or unmapped cache trails fail coverage; empty cache_trails on a declaration emits a Phase 1 warning.
No wave0-scoped output declaration ledger entries found. Complete delegated relay tasks (dpt-source-intake) through the queue + relay pipeline to populate the output declaration ledger.
Wave0 outputs exist on disk but are not covered by output declaration ledger. Files may have been written directly (bypassing relay). Re-run through delegated relay tasks.
No successful wave0 relay slots found in _subagents/wave_00/. Dispatch and complete relay tasks (dpt-source-intake) through the queue + relay pipeline.
